memoryNodes.cueZh: 玛雅考虑一次露营冒险。

data.situation:
On Sunday, 16 May, Maya found Ellen beside the garden gate. A wooden map showed a small maze beyond the hedge, with a bench marked at its centre. They took the left path and soon came back to the same stone bird beside the central bench. Ellen laughed and turned the map round. Beyond the hedge, the garden was tranquil; even the voices from the courtyard seemed distant. On the bench lay a leaflet for a June trip. The group would camp beside a lake, far from the community centre. Maya had never slept in a tent. She liked the idea of an adventure, although she wanted to know who was bringing the cooking equipment. Ellen held down the leaflet while a breeze lifted its corner. LAKESIDE WEEKEND — 5–6 JUNE
Meet at the community centre on Saturday morning. We will camp at the lakeside site, not in the centre's garden. Ask Ellen for the equipment list before booking.
Visitor's note, 16 May: ‘I came for the maze and stayed for the tranquillity. Please keep the bench beside the stone bird.’

readingBlocks.zh: 5月16日星期日，玛雅在花园门边看见了埃伦。木制地图画着树篱后的小迷宫，中央标着一张长椅。她们走左边的小路，不久又回到了中央长椅旁的同一只石鸟边。埃伦笑着把地图转了个方向。树篱后，花园宁静平和，连院子里的说话声都显得遥远。长椅上放着六月出游的传单。大家将在远离社区中心的湖边露营。玛雅从没睡过帐篷。她喜欢这次冒险的念头，不过想知道谁会带炊具。一阵微风掀起传单的一角，埃伦把它按住。

readingBlocks.en:
LAKESIDE WEEKEND — 5–6 JUNE
Meet at the community centre on Saturday morning. We will camp at the lakeside site, not in the centre's garden. Ask Ellen for the equipment list before booking.
Visitor's note, 16 May: ‘I came for the maze and stayed for the tranquillity. Please keep the bench beside the stone bird.’
readingBlocks.zh:
湖畔周末——6月5日至6日
星期六上午在社区中心集合。我们会在湖边营地露营，不是在中心花园里。报名前请向埃伦索取装备清单。
5月16日访客留言：“我为迷宫而来，却因为这里的宁静留了下来。请保留石鸟旁的长椅。”

glossary.note: 可数名词 a maze；本句是花园里有分岔路径的实体迷宫。
glossary.example: The map showed a small maze beyond the hedge.
glossary.exampleZh: 地图画着树篱后的小迷宫。

externalEvidence.definition: complex system of paths or tunnels in which it is easy to get lost

glossary.zh: 不同寻常、令人兴奋的经历
glossary.note: an adventure；这里指此前没有体验过的露营经历。
glossary.example: Maya liked the idea of an adventure.
glossary.exampleZh: 玛雅喜欢这次冒险的念头。

externalEvidence.definition: a wild and exciting undertaking (not necessarily lawful)

glossary.note: 动词 camp；will camp 指计划中的露营，不是名词营地。
glossary.example: The group would camp beside a lake.

externalEvidence.definition: live in or as if in a tent

glossary.note: 形容词修饰/描述地点；the garden was tranquil。
glossary.example: Beyond the hedge, the garden was tranquil.

glossary.note: 不可数名词，the tranquillity 指这里的宁静环境；与形容词 tranquil 语法不同。
glossary.example: I came for the maze and stayed for the tranquillity.
glossary.exampleZh: 我为迷宫而来，却因为这里的宁静留了下来。

externalEvidence.definition: a state of peace and quiet
